## Cells and tissues

Cells are the smallest living units of an organism. Similar cells can work together in a tissue, and several tissues can form an organ.

The cell membrane controls movement into and out of the cell. The nucleus contains genetic information. The cytoplasm is the site of many chemical reactions.

Cells vary in shape because they perform different tasks. A nerve cell carries signals over long distances; a red blood cell transports oxygen.

## Definition: diffusion

Diffusion is the net movement of particles from an area of higher concentration to an area of lower concentration.

## Examples

| Example | Where diffusion occurs |
| --- | --- |
| Perfume | Through the air |
| Oxygen | From alveoli into blood |
